Both nlightjets and dphi plotting selections additionally omit the b-jet pT requirement, not currently stated in the captions.

Fig7.4 now uses MU2500, matching the cutflow parameters. Both Res and NonRes use BSM because it is closer to the historical cutflow in both regions and matches its BSM-only definition.
